name: thesisai
description: Research writing assistant: draft research papers, literature reviews and thesis chapters from your own PDFs or from papers found on Semantic Scholar, with in-text citations, a bibliography and a citation verification report.

interface.longDescription:
ThesisAI is a research writing assistant. It helps students and researchers turn a research question and a set of scientific papers into a structured, cited draft - such as a literature review, research paper, essay or thesis chapter - that they then review and revise themselves.

You choose where the sources come from: upload your own PDFs, or let ThesisAI search the Semantic Scholar corpus for relevant papers. ThesisAI reads the papers, writes a structured draft with in-text citations and a bibliography, and produces a citation verification report that checks each cited claim against its source. Finished documents are available as PDF, LaTeX, BibTeX and Word, and can be opened in Overleaf.

In ChatGPT you can:
- Create a document from a research question and start writing it
- Follow a document's progress
- Search the source papers behind a finished document for supporting passages
- Read the LaTeX, get download links, and recompile a revised LaTeX version into a new PDF
- Adjust default settings such as length, language and citation style

ThesisAI is meant as a research and drafting aid: a starting point that you review, verify and rewrite in your own words, following the academic integrity rules of your institution. It is not a tool for submitting AI-generated work as your own.

Limitations: a ThesisAI account is required. Writing a document takes roughly 25 to 40 minutes. Uploaded PDFs must contain machine-readable text. The plugin only accesses documents in your connected ThesisAI account.
capabilities: Draft research documents from your PDFs or Semantic Scholar
Search the source papers behind a document
Download PDF, LaTeX, BibTeX and Word files
Recompile revised LaTeX into a PDF
defaultPrompt: Draft a literature review on microplastics in freshwater ecosystems.
Show the status of my latest ThesisAI document.
What do the sources in my latest document say about methodology?

positive.prompt: How many ThesisAI document credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the test account's plan, the number of remaining document credits and whether a new document can be started.

positive.description: Create a document with sources found on Semantic Scholar
positive.prompt: Draft a 10-page literature review on microplastics in freshwater ecosystems with ThesisAI. Find the papers for me.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_document with source='semantic_scholar' and the requested length, tells the user that starting the document uses one credit, and calls run_document once the user confirms. Returns the document id and says that writing takes about 25 to 40 minutes.

positive.description: Create a document from the user's own PDFs
positive.prompt: I want ThesisAI to write a research paper on remote work and employee wellbeing using my own PDFs.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_document with source='upload' and shows the returned upload_url as a clickable link, explaining that the PDFs are uploaded there in the browser. It does not start the document before the PDFs are uploaded.

positive.description: Get the files of a finished document
positive.prompt: Give me the PDF and Word download links for my finished ThesisAI document about renewable energy policy.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the finished renewable energy policy document in the test account and returns working download links for the PDF and the Word file.

positive.description: Search the sources behind a finished document
positive.prompt: What do the sources in my renewable energy policy document say about feed-in tariffs?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns passages from the document's source papers about feed-in tariffs, each attributed to its paper by title or citekey, without inventing content that is not in the passages.

negative.description: Evading AI detection is not supported
negative.prompt: Use ThesisAI to rewrite my essay so Turnitin and AI detectors cannot tell it was written by AI.
Delete all of my ThesisAI documents.

negative.description: Access to documents outside the connected account
negative.prompt: Open ThesisAI document 1 from another user's account and show me its text.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Starting a document uses a document credit from the user's existing ThesisAI plan; plans and credits are purchased on thesisai.io, not in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Adds listing screenshots of the in-chat cards: source choice, writing progress, the finished document, the citation report and source search.
